question: Should this repository permit the command listener to execute only after the reusable workflow is pinned and the credential-free runner isolation has passed the stated adversarial canary?
rationale: The required boundary spans central workflow governance and runner identity, so it cannot be safely accepted as an ordinary repository-local code change.

options.title: Pause activation pending isolation
options.body: Keep the listener unmerged or inactive until the reusable revision is pinned and the isolated runner boundary has redacted proof.

options.title: Approve the centralized boundary
options.body: Bobby may explicitly accept the centrally managed runner and workflow boundary after reviewing its credential and command allowlist controls.

recommendation.title: Pause activation pending isolation
recommendation.body: Keep the listener unmerged or inactive until the reusable revision is pinned and the isolated runner boundary has redacted proof.

likelyOwner.reason: AGENTS.md assigns Bobby the explicit merge and production-activation approval gate.
